title: Extra-Principal Credit on a Past-Due Patient Payment Plan
content:
**Patient Financial Services policy — extra principal and a past-due Patient Payment Plan**

**1. Credit.** An extra-principal credit is taken off the installments owed: extra-principal payments received within the current delinquency count in full, because a payment made while an installment stands unpaid goes first to that installment; where none were received in the delinquency but extra principal was received within the last 3 months on a tier whose extra payments do not shorten the term, that extra principal counts up to one installment; otherwise there is no credit, and only installment payments recorded against the delinquency reduce the installments owed. The credit comes off the installments owed together with those installment payments, before the installments owed are held at a floor of zero.

**2. Cure.** A past-due plan is current again when its catch-up amount is paid in one payment, the extra-principal credit standing for the part of the missed installments it covers, whatever the tier's requirement on paying the past-due amount in full.

**3. Placing a payment in time.** Extra-principal payments are placed by the day they were received. A payment lies within the last 3 months when the whole calendar months between that day and the handling date number fewer than 3. "Up to one installment" means the credit is the extra principal received or the installment in force, whichever is less.

## Which tiers' extra payments shorten the term

| Tier | Extra principal shortens the remaining term | Credit for extra principal received within the last 3 months but outside the delinquency |
|---|---|---|
| Short-Term 3-Month Payment Plan | Yes | None |
| Standard 6-Month Payment Plan | Yes | None |
| Extended 10-Month Payment Plan | Yes | None |
| Long-Term 12-Month Payment Plan | Yes | None |
| Large-Balance 18-Month Payment Plan | Yes | None |
| Hardship 24-Month Payment Plan | No | Up to one installment in force |

## Hypothetical cases (installment in force 120.00)

| Extra principal received within the delinquency | Extra principal received within the last 3 months | Tier | Credit |
|---|---|---|---|
| 200.00 | 200.00 | Any | 200.00 (in full) |
| None | 150.00 | Hardship 24-Month Payment Plan | 120.00 (up to one installment) |
| None | 90.00 | Hardship 24-Month Payment Plan | 90.00 |
| None | 150.00 | Standard 6-Month Payment Plan | None |
| None | None | Any | None |
